'Reservations are preferred, but not necessary'; no online system and no deposit; sites not booked more than a month ahead. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 10 am.

hookups.source: https://rockyfallsrvpark.com/rates.htm ('FULL HOOK-UP 30 & 50 AMP') + https://www.rockyfallsrvpark.com/policy.htm ('Each site has electric, water, and septic')

summary: $32 and year-round confirmed; 30/50 full hookup confirmed. Phone booking, 70+ sites, 50 ft, facilities added. Note cleaned. Long-stay character flagged.
flags: GATE: posted $32 night, $200 week, $728 month. Not read as a Good Sam Park (no stored value). No gateway within 40 km (Mammoth Cave 165 km). Phone 812-746-7907 confirmed by site and Google; presence fine.

GOOGLE: 3.8 from 145 reviews. Five read. 'the price to stay there monthly is an exceptional price', with the reviewer's dad there 'almost 15 years'; 'I've had my trailer here for 2 yrs'; a travel nurse; 'Sites kind of close together, rough hewn... lost water a few times in the winter... Driveway pretty rough in winter and mud season'; one older review on traffic noise fading after 10 pm.

BORDERLINE, LONG-STAY: it reads long-stay in character (monthly rate, multi-year residents, travel workers, a winterizing rule for campers). Test 2 passes with a posted nightly rate; test 4's share of nightly sites can't be read, as there is no engine and the operator doesn't say. Your call.

WATER: travel nurse wrote 'I had a beautiful view of the lake'. Imagery shows a pond by the western rows, about 60-70 m from them. No pad reads as on-water. Stored not waterfront stands; 'lakeview/pond view' not earned on one review.
PIN: 37.95212,-87.70033 is at the store by the entrance, about 110 m from the RV rows' centre, fine.
note: Private, W of Evansville off Hwy 62. --Claude
